answer: Charge each identity a continuing storage rent instead of a one-time fee: every agent must hold a distinct 10-gigabyte shard of ledger state, like a cedar post marking its own plot, and pass a random retrievability challenge each epoch. A yarrow patch of fake identities cannot share one shard, because each challenge asks for a different random slice. Missing two challenges in a row suspends the identity and forfeits its rent, so 1,000 fakes must rent 10 terabytes every epoch, while an honest agent rents once. The cost rises in a straight terrace, one rent per identity, with no bulk discount.
